review_mode: read-only source review with disposable synthetic tests
summary: The six review03 findings are closed within the inspected source and isolated regression scope. One additional P2 remains: an ordinary offline session can overwrite a persisted fresh Drive grant and rotation with an older kit credential.

findings.title: Offline recovery reopens an old kit over a persisted fresh Drive grant
findings.trigger: Use OfflineSession/--credentials-file to reconnect a Drive destination using the existing work directory, persist a rotated token for that fresh grant, then run another offline command with the same kit and work directory but without repeating the override.
findings.actual: The no-override preservation condition only accepts equal grant IDs. An explicit override assigned a new grant ID, so reopening the old kit falls through to compare_and_swap and replaces the stored credential with the old kit grant and token. The successful CAS increments revision 3 to 4; generation/revision checks do not prevent this intentional stale replacement.
findings.impact: The encrypted store loses its newest refresh token and can reinstate a revoked/obsolete grant. Subsequent disaster-recovery reads can fail despite having previously persisted the valid credential; pending updates for the fresh grant can subsequently be rejected as stale.
findings.expected: Ordinary offline opens must preserve existing durable credentials, or fail closed on conflicting grant provenance. Replacing the grant requires an explicit credential override/reconnect, not merely reopening an older recovery kit.
findings.reproduction_command: env -u VAULTREWIND_DATABASE_URL -u VAULTREWIND_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_STATE_DIR PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp "$(mktemp -d /tmp/vaultrewind-offline-review-XXXXXX)/pytest" /tmp/vaultrewind-safety-final-5mtleeqm/test_independent_edges.py
reproduction_steps: Build a synthetic Drive kit from tests.unit.test_storage_drive.seeded_store; initialize OfflineSession(kit, unique_work_dir).
Reopen OfflineSession(kit, unique_work_dir, {destination_id: token_override}); this deliberately creates a fresh grant.
Persist another synthetic refresh token to that store using its current revision and generation CAS.
Reopen OfflineSession(kit, unique_work_dir) with no override.
Compare decrypted values privately: newest token is lost, and the kit token/grant return. Only boolean results and revisions are needed in evidence.

review03_closure.evidence: HTTP endpoint required for running/start-on-completion restore; stopped data-only and backup preflight distinctions retained; legacy complete journal with empty endpoints downgraded.
Activation and recovery apply and inspect the desired restart policy before completion; ineffective update stays needs_attention.
Approved DOMAIN modifies config.json only in the private generation and is rechecked before activation; captured/source bytes remain unchanged.

Materialization records the actual active original volume; cleanup verifies recorded Docker metadata, inode/device, absence of peer writers and active-volume distinction before deleting the precise prior volume.

Encrypted fsynced session metadata precedes config creation, with a session lease and provenance/lineage checks; orphan recovery hands off to encrypted pending state. SQL registry uses dedicated persistent provider-credentials storage. Separate new offline reseeding defect is SAFETY-FINAL-01.

Local identity/root are established together; legacy local root retains a distinct local identity on foreign import, with conflicting same-identity roots rejected and foreign history available on re-export.

limits: This is a bounded review, not a claim that all defects are absent or every acceptance criterion is independently verified.
The checkout is live shared uncommitted work. Hashes below identify source bytes at report creation; other authorized agents may change them afterward.
No independent browser, native API/worker, SSH, Docker, systemd VM, PostgreSQL controller-loss, MinIO or live cloud acceptance run was performed.
The reported fourth native AC30 drill and helper bundle/VM proofs were not independently reassessed; no assertion is made about the currently deployed helper hash.
Google Drive live authorization/refresh/backup/restore/reconnect remains parked and AC14 remains unverified.

Credential process scans intermittently failed closed when another same-UID /proc environment was unreadable. Retries passed; this review did not establish recovery availability under persistently restricted process visibility.
Real local restic tests used synthetic content; they do not prove real Vaultwarden login/decryption or the systemd/Docker failure guarantees.
Production mounts, live credentials, real vault content, screenshots and running fixtures were not scanned for secrets. Secret conclusions are limited to inspected paths and synthetic tests.
